## vbt-p01–p03 — question and first dhāraṇās
**SUMMARY.** Śrutaṃ deva mayā sarvaṃ rudrayāmalasambhavam — I have heard all, Lord, arising from Rudrayāmala. Trikabhedam aśeṣeṇa sārāt sāravibhāgaśaḥ — Trika division, completely, essence from essence. Adyāpi na nivṛtto me saṃśayaḥ parameśvara — even now, doubt not removed, supreme Lord. Kiṃ rūpaṃ tattvato deva śabdarāśikalāmayam — what form, in truth, Lord, made of word-group and kalā. Kiṃ vā navātmabhedena bhairave bhairavākṛtau — or by nine-ātman division, in Bhairava, in Bhairava-form. Triśirobhedabhinnaṃ vā kiṃ vā śaktitrayātmakam — or divided by three-head division, or made of three śaktis. Nādabindumayaṃ vāpi kiṃ candrārdhanirodhikāḥ — or made of nāda-bindu, or half-moon obstructions. Cakrārūḍham anackaṃ vā kiṃ vā śaktitrayātmakam — or wheel-mounted, anacka, or made of three śaktis. Dhāraṇās 1-20 (various practices) follow.

**FUNCTION.** Devī's question about Bhairava's true form; first 20 dhāraṇās.

**KEY TERMS.** rudrayāmala (Rudrayāmala), trika (Trika), śabdarāśi (word-group), kalā (kalā), navātman (nine-ātman), triśira (three-head), śaktitraya (three śaktis), nāda (nāda), bindu (bindu), candrārdha (half-moon), cakrārūḍha (wheel-mounted), anacka (anacka), dhāraṇā (practice).

**LOCAL CONTEXT.** First three passages; sets the doctrinal frame.

**EXPLANATION.** The passage moves in two steps. (1) Question: I have heard all, Lord, arising from Rudrayāmala; Trika division, completely, essence from essence; even now, doubt not removed, supreme Lord; what form, in truth, Lord, made of word-group and kalā; or by nine-ātman division; or divided by three-head division; or made of nāda-bindu; or wheel-mounted, anacka. (2) Dhāraṇās 1-20: various practices follow.

**BOUNDARY / OPEN.** None major. Verses are dense; L2 groups them.

**RELATED.** A01 (svabhāva), A11 (śaktipāta), spans TS1.1–1.30.

source.text: nādabindumayo vāpi na candrārdhanirodhikāḥ | na cakrakramasambhinno na ca śaktisvarūpakaḥ aprabuddhamatīnāṃ hi etā balavibhīṣikāḥ | mātṛmodakavat sarvaṃ pravṛttyarthaṃ udāhṛtam dikkālakalanonmuktā deśoddeśāviśeṣinī | vyapadeṣṭum aśakyāsāv akathyā paramārthataḥ antaḥsvānubhavānandā vikalponmuktagocarā | yāvasthā bharitākārā bhairavī bhairavātmanaḥ tad vapus tattvato jñeyaṃ vimalaṃ viśvapūraṇam | evaṃvidhe pare tattve kaḥ pūjyaḥ kaś ca tṛpyati evaṃvidhā bhairavasya yāvasthā parigīyate | sā parā pararūpeṇa parā devī prakīrtitā śaktiśaktimator yadvad abhedaḥ sarvadā sthitaḥ | atas taddharmadharmitvāt parā śaktiḥ parātmanaḥ na vahner dāhikā śaktir vyatiriktā vibhāvyate | kevalaṃ jñānasattāyām prārambho 'yam praveśane śaktyavasthāpraviṣṭasya nirvibhāgena bhāvanā | tadāsau śivarūpī syāt śaivī mukham ihocyate yathālokena dīpasya kiraṇair bhāskarasya ca | jñāyate digvibhāgādi tadvac chaktyā śivaḥ priye

source.text: jīvann api vimukto 'sau kurvann api na lipyate | śrī devī uvāca | idaṃ yadi vapur deva parāyāś ca maheśvara evamuktavyavasthāyāṃ japyate ko japaś ca kaḥ | dhyāyate ko mahānātha pūjyate kaś ca tṛpyati hūyate kasya vā homo yāgaḥ kasya ca kiṃ katham | śrī bhairava uvāca | eṣātra prakriyā bāhyā sthūleṣv eva mṛgekṣaṇe bhūyo bhūyaḥ pare bhāve bhāvanā bhāvyate hi yā | japaḥ so 'tra svayaṃ nādo mantrātmā japya īdṛśaḥ dhyānaṃ hi niścalā buddhir nirākārā nirāśrayā | na tu dhyānaṃ śarīrākṣimukhahastādikalpanā pūjā nāma na puṣpādyair yā matiḥ kriyate dṛḍhā | nirvikalpe mahāvyomni sā pūjā hy ādarāl layaḥ atraikatamayuktisthe yotpadyeta dinād dinam | bharitākāratā sātra tṛptir atyantapūrṇatā mahāśūnyālaye vahnau bhūtākṣaviṣayādikam | hūyate manasā sārdhaṃ sa homaś cetanāsrucā yāgo 'tra parameśāni tuṣṭir ānandalakṣaṇā | kṣapaṇāt sarvapāpānāṃ trāṇāt sarvasya pārvati rudraśaktisamāveśas tat kṣetram bhāvanā parā | anyathā tasya tattvasya kā pūjā kāś ca tṛpyati

source.text: svatantrānandacinmātrasāraḥ svātmā hi sarvataḥ | āveśanaṃ tatsvarūpe svātmanaḥ snānam īritam yair eva pūjyate dravyais tarpyate vā parāparaḥ | yaś caiva pūjakaḥ sarvaḥ sa evaikaḥ kva pūjanam vrajet prāṇo viśej jīva icchayā kuṭilākṛtiḥ | dīrghātmā sā mahādevī parakṣetram parāparā asyām anucaran tiṣṭhan mahānandamaye 'dhvare | tayā devyā samāviṣṭaḥ param bhairavam āpnuyāt ṣaṭśatāni divā rātrau sahasrāṇyekaviṃśatiḥ | japo devyāḥ samuddiṣṭaḥ sulabho durlabho jaḍaiḥ ity etat kathitaṃ devi paramāmṛtam uttamam | etac ca naiva kasyāpi prakāśyaṃ tu kadācana paraśiṣye khale krūre abhakte gurupādayoḥ | nirvikalpamatīnāṃ tu vīrāṇām unnatātmanām bhaktānāṃ guruvargasya dātavyaṃ nirviśaṅkayā | grāmo rājyam puraṃ deśaḥ putradārakuṭumbakam sarvam etat parityajya grāhyam etan mṛgekṣaṇe | kim ebhir asthirair devi sthiram param idaṃ dhanam | prāṇā api pradātavyā na deyaṃ paramāmṛtam śrī devī uvāca | devadeva māhadeva paritṛptāsmi śaṅkara | rudrayāmalatantrasya sāram adyāvadhāritam
